name: pmh-3/Song-Heap
description: The program below stores the Billboard 100 in a minimum heap using a dynamic array implementation. The program automatically reads in song information from a csv file and inputs into heap, doubling array size as needed. The title is used as the key and the songs are sorted alphabetically such that A<B<C.

name: pmh-3/Binary-Song-Tree
description: The program below stores songs and their information in a binary search tree using a linked implementation. The driver automatically populates tree by reading in a local csv file.
